title: pdcontrol
description: communicate with pd and/or this patch

messages.description: open a URL given by the symbol
output patch's directory. optional float and symbol set depth and file name
outputs float to specify if patch is visible (1) or not (0)
outputs patch's argument. optional float sets depth
list of args, dir symbol, or visibility float

methods.description: outputs the patch's directory. Optional float sets level of enclosing patch, optional symbol appends a path
outputs the patch's invocation arguments. Float sets level of enclosing patch
opens a URL in a web browser
outputs 1 if the patch is visible, 0 otherwise

body:
pdcontrol lets you open a URL in a web browser or communicate with the patch to get its owning directory, arguments or its visible/invisible state.

Optional argument to specify this patch (0), owning patch (1), its own owner (2), and so on, and optionally also a filename relative to the patch's directory. (Ownership number is silently reduced if owners don't exist, so here anything greater than zero is ignored.)
